name: Table
purpose: Present a large, sortable, filterable set of records - the workhorse of list/index ("All X") pages.
intent: A data-table shell: a section header (title + description + actions), a toolbar (search + filter/configure icon buttons + active-filter Chip mode='filter' pills), a column-config-driven grid (sortable headers, a selection column, row/loading/empty states), and a pagination footer. Driven by `columns` + `data`; sorting and selection are owned by default (uncontrolled) with controlled overrides, while pagination and search are controlled for server-driven data. Composes Text Field, Chip, Checkbox, Icon Button, Button, Skeleton, Empty State, and Pagination into one complete section - which is why it lives at the organism tier.
nativeElement: table (semantic thead/tbody/th/td, with a visually-hidden caption)

figmaSource.note: Not a variant set: the `table` frame (2949:40357) holds two size components - size=md (2949:40355) and size=sm (2949:40356). The Figma page is marked in-progress (✅⏲️), and the grid renders empty in the master because its cells live in the separate 'Parts' library (a `figma-parts / column / <type>` per cell content type). Verified live via figma-dev-mode.

subParts.name: table / head
subParts.note: The section header: {title} (heading/lg), {description} (body/md, content/subtle), and a right-aligned button-group of two Buttons + an overflow Icon Button. Maps to the `title` / `description` / `actions` props.

subParts.name: table / filters
subParts.note: The toolbar: a search Text Field (left, flex-growing up to 600px) + filter/configure Icon Buttons (right), a row of Chip mode='filter' active-filter pills + a '+' add-filter Icon Button + a 'Clear all filters' action (right), over a bottom border separator. Code maps this to search (`searchable`) + `toolbarActions` (Icon Buttons) + `activeFilters` (consumer-rendered Chip mode='filter' ReactNode) + `onClearFilters`. The filter/configure dropdowns are consumer-owned.

subParts.name: table / columns
subParts.note: The grid, laid out column-by-column: a 24px left/right gutter (`column / padding`), up to 8 (wide) or 16 (narrow) column slots, and vertical/horizontal scrollbars. In code this is a normal row-oriented <table>; the per-column layout is expressed as the `columns` config.

subParts.name: cell / table-head
subParts.note: The header cell (deep-verified via the Desktop Bridge): background elevation/surface/default (a subtle grey band vs. the white body rows), a Title label in heading/xs SemiBold coloured content/SUBTLE (not default), an always-visible sort Icon Button (arrow_down) + a column-menu (⋮) dropdown, a vertical drag-handle divider (border/default) between columns, and a bottom border (border/default). Header height 40 (md) / 32 (sm). Code renders the sort control (asc/desc/none, with aria-sort; the arrow stays visible and takes content/default when active) and defers the column-menu ⋮ and drag-resize to future work.

subParts.name: cell / text (and 20+ other cell types)
subParts.note: Body cell (deep-verified): content at --spacing-sm inline padding, body/md, content/default, transparent background, with a bottom row divider (--color-border-default). Row height 64 (md) / 40 (sm). Figma ships a `column / <type>` for each cell content type; the code does NOT hard-code these - a column's `render` returns any content composed from existing atoms/molecules (see cellContentTypes).

subParts.name: container-pagination
subParts.note: The footer: the Pagination molecule, centered, over a top border.

figmaSource.cellContentTypesNote: The Figma cell content types the grid is designed to hold (from the 'Parts' `figma-parts / column / <type>` list, verified live 2026-09-10). The code expresses these through a column's `render` prop rather than one component per type; a built-in selection Checkbox column is the exception.
apiAdaptationNotes: Column-config driven, not slot-composed. Figma lays the grid out as columns, each a stack of a header cell + body cells of one content type; the code takes `columns` (with `key`, `header`, `sortable`, `align`, `width`, `render`) + `data` and renders a semantic row-oriented <table>. This scales to a data-heavy app (many similar 'All X' pages) far better than hand-composed rows.

Cells render arbitrary content via `column.render` rather than a component-per-content-type. Figma's 20+ `column / <type>` parts are examples of what a cell can hold (Tag, Avatar, Link, Badge, Button, ...); baking a renderer for each would be a combinatorial, low-value surface. The one structural exception is the selection Checkbox column (`selectable`).

Batteries-included but controllable. Sorting and selection are owned by default (uncontrolled: `defaultSort` / `defaultSelectedIds`) with controlled overrides (`sort`+`onSortChange`, `selectedIds`+`onSelectionChange`). The built-in sort reorders `data` client-side; `manualSort` hands sorting to the consumer (server-side).

Pagination is controlled or client-side. Pass `pageSize` for client-side slicing (the table computes the page count and owns the page), or `manualPagination` + `page`/`pageCount`/`onPageChange` for server-driven paging. Search is always controlled (`searchValue`/`onSearchChange`) - the consumer owns the data query.

The toolbar renders the shell (search + `toolbarActions` Icon Buttons + active-filter Chip mode='filter' pills + Clear all filters); the filter/configure dropdowns are consumer-owned, since specific filter categories do not generalise. Pass `toolbar` to replace the built-in toolbar entirely.

Accessibility: a real <table> with a visually-hidden <caption> (or the `title`) for the accessible name; sortable headers set aria-sort and wrap the label in a <button>; the scroll region is a keyboard-focusable role=region; `aria-busy` marks the loading state.

Token fidelity was confirmed via the Desktop Bridge deep read (resolving boundVariables to token names): header cell background = elevation/surface/default, header text = content/subtle, cell text = content/default, all borders/dividers = border/default. The row HOVER and SELECTED backgrounds are not specified in the (in-progress ⏲️) Figma page, so they use inferred semantic tokens (neutral-overlay-subtle-hover / brand-primary-subtle) - revisit them when the design specifies row states.

Deferred from v1 (Figma page is in-progress): single-select (radio) column, the per-column ⋮ menu, column resize/reorder, sticky first column, and row expansion. The sortable header + selection Checkbox cover the primary interactions.

useCases: an 'All members' / 'All records' list page with search, filters, sorting, and pagination
a selectable list with bulk actions (select-all + per-row checkboxes)
a compact dense table (size='sm') for data-heavy views
a server-driven table (manualSort + manualPagination) backed by a paged API
antiPatterns: a simple key/value layout or a short static list (use a description list or plain markup)
a layout grid / dashboard of cards (use layout primitives, not a data table)
editable spreadsheet-style grids with cell-level editing and formulas (out of scope)

anatomy.description: Flex column of the header, the card, spaced by --spacing-lg.
Rendered when there's a title, description, or actions. Heading area (title heading/lg + description body/md subtle) + right-aligned actions.
Raised surface (no border or radius per Figma) holding the toolbar, the grid scroll region, and the footer. data-has-footer marks whether a pagination footer is shown.

When one or more rows are selected, the column-header <th> cells are REPLACED by this row: the select-all Checkbox stays, then the selected count (left) + `bulkActions` (right) on a brand-primary-subtle band.

Rendered for `toolbar`, `searchable`, `toolbarActions`, `onClearFilters`, or `activeFilters`. Row 1: search (left, flex-grow) + toolbarActions (right). Row 2: activeFilters Chips + Clear all filters. Bottom border separator.
The horizontally/vertically scrollable, keyboard-focusable region wrapping the <table>.
Semantic table with a visually-hidden <caption> for its accessible name; aria-busy while loading.
Sticky header cell (elevation/surface/default band, content/subtle heading/xs); sortable columns wrap the label + sort arrow in a <button>.
Drag handle at the header cell's trailing edge (Figma's drag-handle divider); resizes the column by pointer drag or Arrow keys. Shown when resizableColumns and column.resizable !== false.
Leading column with a header select-all Checkbox and a per-row Checkbox; shown when `selectable`. Selection is checkbox-only - rows are never clickable.
Body row; a bottom row divider on its cells (dropped when it is the only row). Hover background only when selection is enabled (neutral overlay); brand-tinted when selected.
Body cell; body/md (heading weight when column.emphasis='strong' for an identifier); renders `column.render(row)` or `row[key]`.
Centered Pagination (no top border); shown when pagination is enabled and there's more than one page.

columns.description: Column definitions (key, header, render, sortable, align, width, resizable, emphasis, ...). column.resizable=false opts a column out of resizing; column.emphasis='strong' marks an identifier column (heading weight).

data.description: The row data. Sorted/paginated unless the matching manual flag is set.

getRowId.description: Stable row id for selection and React keys. Pass a real id when using selection.

size.description: Row density: md (64px rows) or sm (40px rows).

caption.description: Accessible name for the <table> (visually-hidden caption). Falls back to `title`.

actions.description: Right-aligned header actions (Buttons + overflow Icon Button).

toolbarActions.description: Right-aligned toolbar actions beside the search field — typically a filter Icon Button and a configure Icon Button. The consumer owns the buttons and their dropdown/popover content.

activeFilters.description: Applied filter chips rendered below the search row. Pass Chip mode='filter' components and an optional '+' IconButton. The consumer renders the chips directly so filter-chip segments stay fully controlled.

onClearFilters.description: When set, renders a 'Clear all filters' action at the trailing edge of the chip row.

manualSort.description: Consumer sorts server-side; Table reflects state but does not reorder data.

selectable.description: Enable the leading selection Checkbox column + header select-all.

bulkActions.description: Actions shown on the right of the selection bar when one or more rows are selected.

pageSize.description: Rows per page; enables client-side pagination.

manualPagination.description: Consumer paginates server-side; Table shows pageCount pages and does not slice.

resizableColumns.description: Allow dragging column-header edges (and Arrow keys on the handle) to resize columns.

empty.description: Shown when there are no rows.

className.description: Composes with the root class list.

slots.name: columns[].render
supports: arbitrary cell content - Text, Tag, Avatar, Avatar Group, Link, Badge, Button, Icon Button, Progress Bar, Toggle, inline editors, ...

color.resizeHandleDivider: --color-border-default @16% opacity 1px (default) → --color-border-bold 1px (hover/pressed); handle width stays 1px in all states

requirements: A semantic <table> with thead/tbody/th(scope=col)/td and a visually-hidden <caption> (or the title) as the accessible name - always give it a name.
Sortable headers set aria-sort (ascending/descending/none) and wrap the label in a <button labelled 'Sort by {column}'>.

The selection column uses real Checkboxes; the header select-all is labelled and goes indeterminate when only some visible rows are selected. Selection is checkbox-only - rows are never clickable, so controls inside a row act independently.
Column resize handles are role=separator (aria-orientation=vertical), keyboard-focusable, and operable with Arrow keys.
The scrollable grid is a keyboard-focusable role=region with an accessible name (WCAG 2.1.1).
The loading state sets aria-busy on the table; skeletons are decorative.
Row content composed via render must remain accessible (e.g. give action buttons labels).

keyboardInteraction: Tab reaches the toolbar controls, the sortable header buttons, the selection checkboxes, in-cell controls, the scroll region, and the pagination.
Enter/Space on a sortable header button cycles the sort (ascending → descending → unsorted).
Enter/Space toggles a selection checkbox; the header checkbox toggles all visible rows.
A focused column resize handle resizes with ArrowLeft / ArrowRight.
The scroll region is focusable so it can be scrolled by keyboard.
behaviorRules: Render the grid from `columns` + `data`; a cell shows `column.render(row)` or `String(row[key])`.
Sorting is uncontrolled by default (defaultSort) and controlled via sort+onSortChange; the built-in sort reorders data client-side unless manualSort.
Sort cycles ascending → descending → unsorted per column.

Selection is checkbox-only (rows are never clickable), uncontrolled by default (defaultSelectedIds) and controlled via selectedIds+onSelectionChange; select-all operates over the visible (current-page) rows.
When one or more rows are selected, the column-header <th> cells are REPLACED by the selection bar: the select-all Checkbox stays, then the selected count (left) + bulkActions (right).

All rows show a neutral-overlay-bold hover (aids horizontal scanning); the selected state is brand-tinted. A single row - or the last row when there is no pagination footer - drops its bottom divider.

Columns are resizable by default (resizableColumns): drag the header-edge separator or use Arrow keys; per-column opt-out via column.resizable=false. The first resize freezes every column's width (fixed table-layout) so a resize doesn't reflow the others and the widths persist across page/data changes.
column.emphasis='strong' renders a cell at the heading weight (an identifier); otherwise body weight.
Pagination is client-side when pageSize is set (Table slices + owns the page) or server-driven when manualPagination (Table shows pageCount pages).

loading shows skeleton rows and sets aria-busy; an empty data set shows the empty slot (default: an informative/sunken Empty State whose background meets the card edges - the empty cell has no padding).
Render the header when there's a title/description/actions; render the toolbar for search/filters/clear/active-filters; render the footer when pagination is enabled and there's more than one page.
interactionRules: Checkbox = row selection. Never use a row click for selection; rows are not clickable.
Link = navigation/routing. If a value is an entity, it must be a Link; a single primary destination can also be a dedicated Link/action near the row's trailing edge.
Button = action. Use Buttons for operations that change state, not for plain navigation.
Interactive controls inside a row (links, buttons, menus, checkboxes) behave independently and never trigger another row-level interaction.
Identifier typography: strong (heading weight, or a strong Link) for the name / first-column identifier; default (body weight, or a default Link) for every other column.
compositionRules: Give the table an accessible name via `caption` or `title`.
Pass a real `getRowId` whenever `selectable` (or sorting/pagination reorder rows).
Compose rich cells with `column.render` (Tag, Avatar, Link, Button, ...); keep them accessible.
Mark the identifier column with `emphasis: 'strong'` (and, if it routes, a `<Link emphasis="strong">`); leave other columns at body weight / default Links.
Provide `bulkActions` (Buttons) for the selection bar when `selectable`.
Pass filter/configure Icon Buttons through `toolbarActions`; render Chip mode='filter' through `activeFilters`; drive filter state from the consumer.
For large/server datasets, use manualSort + manualPagination and fetch on the callbacks.
contentRules: Header labels are short noun phrases; align numeric columns to the end.
Keep the title a short phrase and the description one line.
responsiveRules: The grid scrolls horizontally within its region on narrow viewports; the card and toolbar wrap.
Set explicit `column.width` / `minWidth` to control wrapping and horizontal scroll.
themeRules: Must work in light and dark themes - all colours use semantic tokens.
implementationNotes: Generic over the row type, written as a plain function component (React.memo would erase the generic).
Use CSS Modules + design tokens only; row/header heights and the selection column width are structural px (not token-gated).

Compose existing components: Text Field (search), Select (filters), Chip (active filters), Checkbox (selection), Button / Icon Button (actions), Skeleton (loading), Empty State (empty), Pagination (footer).
No MUI. No Tailwind. No hardcoded colours, spacing, radius, or typography.
do: Give every table an accessible name (caption or title).
Use `render` to compose cell content from existing atoms/molecules.
Select rows with checkboxes; provide bulkActions for the selection bar.
Mark the identifier column emphasis='strong' (and a strong Link if it routes).
Use manualSort + manualPagination for server-driven data; pass a stable getRowId when selecting.
dont: Don't use a data table for a simple key/value layout or a card grid.
Don't make whole rows clickable - selection is checkbox-only and navigation is a Link/action.
Don't rely on index-based row ids with selection when rows can reorder.
Don't bake domain-specific filter logic into the table - pass filter/configure buttons via `toolbarActions` and Chip mode='filter' via `activeFilters`.
Don't forget an accessible name, or labels on in-cell action controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders a semantic role=table named by caption/title; columns render row[key] by default or column.render.
Sortable headers cycle asc/desc/none, set aria-sort, and reorder data client-side (unless manualSort, which only fires onSortChange).
selectable adds a Checkbox column with a header select-all that goes indeterminate; selection is controllable and checkbox-only (rows are not clickable).
Selecting rows shows the selection bar (count + bulkActions); rows show a neutral-overlay hover only when selectable; a lone row drops its bottom divider.
Columns resize via a role=separator header handle (pointer drag + Arrow keys); resizableColumns=false / column.resizable=false opt out.
column.emphasis='strong' renders the cell at the heading weight.
pageSize paginates client-side; manualPagination shows pageCount pages; search is controlled.
loading shows skeleton rows + aria-busy; an empty data set shows an informative (sunken) Empty State by default.
Composes className + data-size; uses only semantic tokens; works in light and dark themes.
Storybook includes Basic, Sortable, Selectable, Pagination, Sizes, WithToolbar, Loading, Empty, and FullShell.

Tests cover render/default+custom cell, sort (client + manual), selection + select-all/indeterminate + checkbox-only, selection bar, resize handles, emphasis, client pagination, loading, empty, search, and size/className.
knownLimitations: Single-select (radio) column, the per-column ⋮ menu, column reorder, sticky first column, and row expansion are deferred (the Figma page is still in-progress).
The built-in client-side sort compares row[key] (or column.sortValue) with a general comparator; complex/locale-specific sorts need manualSort.
Resized column widths are session-only state (not persisted) and reset on remount.
futureEnhancements: Single-select (radio) rows and the per-column options menu.
Column reorder, a sticky first column, and persisted column widths.
